answer: Macaroons carry caveats that attenuate rights at each delegation hop. A leaked macaroon grants only its caveats, so 549 stolen tokens yield 549 narrowly scoped powers. Caveats are verified by the service on every use, and expired caveats fail. The trellis check runs in the open: 549 fakes pay the full price 549 times, one honest agent pays once, and the pigment trail in the ledger makes the ember cost visible to everyone.
